rules.name: No leftover placeholder
rules.rationale: Placeholders (TODO, FIXME, foobar, lorem ipsum) must never survive into a shared draft — they signal an unfinished thought.

examples.after: We evaluate on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.

rules.name: Cut empty intensifiers
rules.rationale: Empty intensifiers (very, really, quite, rather) pad a claim without adding information. A precise word or number makes them unnecessary.
